thread:
elaine (support): heads-up — OptimumAI reporting huge tail latency (p95->p99) + intermittent 503s on their Dedicated pool in eu2 (pool: eu2-ded-11). Started ~2026-03-12T10:15Z. They call it 'throttling' but app logs show backend 503s.

Tariq (eng-infra): what model / MIG config are they on? request qps and burst pattern?

elaine (support): model: opt-redwood-13b (v2.1), pool: eu2-ded-11, MIG layout: mixed (one 7g.40gb + 3 x 1g.5gb) per node per customer. Their traffic: steady 25 qps, spikes to ~120 qps for short bursts. Saw autoscaler activity but no new nodes added during spike window.

Julian (cs): customer pasted their client logs: "503 backend overloaded" + >500ms connect times. They've got billing/contract committed capacity for this pool.

Maria (sre): pulled node metrics — NVML shows high SM util on one host and low on siblings. Possible noisy neighbor on shared host. Posting prometheus excerpt:

```
redwood_gpu_sm_util{node="eu2-ded-11-node-3",mig_profile="1g"} 97.8
redwood_gpu_sm_util{node="eu2-ded-11-node-3",mig_profile="7g"} 22.1
redwood_gpu_memory_used_bytes{node="eu2-ded-11-node-3",mig_profile="1g"} 4.8e9
redwood_gpu_power_draw_watts{node="eu2-ded-11-node-3"} 260
```

Maria (sre): also seeing L3 cache thrash counters high on that node. suspect multiple heavy-inference tenants on 1g slices causing SM saturation + cache contention.

Devina (runtime): can you paste the runtime logs for the 503s? need to see kv cache eviction messages / OOMs / throttles.

elaine (support): paste from customer (curl repro attached):

```
$ curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer <opt-token>" -d '{"model":"opt-redwood-13b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize ..."}]}' -w "HTTP:%{http_code} T:%{time_total}\n"
HTTP:503 T:0.512
HTTP:503 T:1.42
HTTP:200 T:0.08
```

Tariq (eng-infra): autoscaler events? ops-bot, did the pool hit any quota or constraints?

ops-bot: [autoscaler] event @ 2026-03-12T10:16:02Z: pool eu2-ded-11 attempted scale +2 nodes, prevented by per-region GPU-host quota (limit: 40 hosts). Current hosts: 40.

Tariq (eng-infra): bingo — autoscaler wanted to add capacity but region quota blocked it. That explains why autoscale didn't mitigate the spike. However, that doesn't explain the node-level SM skew — noisy neighbor still possible.

Devina (runtime): propose immediate mitigation: 1) move OptimumAI pods off the hot node; 2) temporarily pin them to larger MIG slices if they have reserved capacity; 3) if necessary, promote them to dedicated whole-hosts for a short window.

Maria (sre): suggested kubectl drain cmd (one-off) — sample: 

```
kubectl drain eu2-ded-11-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
# then cordon and create replacement host if autoscaler can add later
```

Tariq (eng-infra): ops team note — we can't bump region quota urgently without approvals. Short-term we can evict and redistribute. Also check MIG placement imbalance: it looks like higher density of 1g consumer workloads landed on node-3. Need to rebalance MIG assignments.

Devina (runtime): quick anti-noise firewall: enable per-tenant sm_limit config (soft cap) to reduce single-MIG SM takeover. We can flip via API: 

PATCH /pools/eu2-ded-11/config 
body: { "tenant_overcommit": false, "per_tenant_sm_softlimit_pct": 75 }

(ops: will require a rolling restart of the pool controller.)

Julian (cs): customer is asking for an ETA. Can we offer a 1-2 hour mitigation plan?

Maria (sre): immediate ETA: do drain -> redistribute (~20-30 mins), enable softlimit and monitor p95/p99 (~10 mins to take effect), if still bad escalate to host isolation (1-2 hours). Recommend we inform customer and schedule move.

elaine (support): I'm creating a ticket for ops change and asking OptimumAI if they can tolerate a brief failover window. Also asking for their burst schedule to recommend reserved node or whole-host reservation.

sre-bot: [alert] high tail-latency detected on pool eu2-ded-11. correlated with GPU host eu2-ded-11-node-3. Incident ID: INC-20260312-8742.

Tariq (eng-infra): follow-up tasks: 1) ops: perform drain + redistribute; 2) infra: request short-term quota bump for eu2 region or shift some tenants to eu3; 3) runtime: enable per-tenant SM softlimit; 4) cs: offer customer temporary dedicated host if spike recurs.

Devina (runtime): note for postmortem: consider smarter MIG packing to avoid collocating many small-slice high-qps tenants on same host. Add a scheduler constraint to spread 1g slices across nodes. I'll open a design doc.

elaine (support): I'll update OptimumAI and route the ticket to ops + infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:
